2. Calculating the appropriate pro‑rated credit.
3. Submitting the required senior‑manager approval request.
4. Coordinating with our Finance Refund Team to apply the approved credit to your account.

We will keep you informed of each step and let you know as soon as the credit has been approved and posted. Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
Customer Success Team
